specs: High-quality materials for durability and health: This set is made of E1 grade eco-friendly triamine board and marble grain surface, making it environmentally friendly and health conscious. The good density and strong compression of the tabletop create a smooth, hard-textured surface that can bear considerable weight without deforming. The 2.5 cm thick tabletop with rounded corners improves both aesthetics and protection against impact.

Stable construction for improved load-bearing capacity: The M-shaped metal frame with reinforced discs increases the load-bearing capacity of the table. Its balanced design ensures mechanical stability, while the high-temperature painted metal steel frame guarantees durability and reliable load-bearing capacity. In addition, the type A chair legs made of thickened metal tubes as well as the thickened one-piece metal table legs are treated with high-temperature baking varnish for corros

Compact 4-piece design with style flexibility: The dining set comes in two sizes with 80cm diameter and easily matches any home decor. The chairs are versatile and can be used as coffee or dining chairs. The set offers two fabric types to choose from: breathable cotton linen or sturdy oil wax leather. Cotton linen offers softness and comfort while PU leather exudes sturdiness and smooth patterns. This adaptable design complements different decor styles.

Comfort-Focused Design with Aesthetic Elegance: The design of the chairs emphasizes comfort and features an angled and curved backrest that conforms to the contours of the body. The breathable and wear-resistant backrest with its arched curve provides sturdy support while ensuring a comfortable sitting experience. The bean bag filled with high-density sponge with a density of 35kg/m3 provides remarkable support, elasticity and comfort, ensuring prolonged use without collapse.

Space-saving for versatile use: The compact design of the negotiating table and chair set is ideal for optimizing small spaces without compromising on style. Suitable for various occasions, from chess rooms and libraries to offices, supermarkets and cafes, this versatile set offers both functionality and elegance. Whether in living rooms, bedrooms, libraries, cinemas or lounges, the set blends harmoniously into different environments.
